title: Conversation Loop
paragraphs: “Gaelion-chan had the same look in his eyes as Sasa-chan. That’s why Naofumi-chan let them go together.”
“Dragons like treasure,” Assistant adds.
Ah, so that’s why Rival isn’t here.
“Yeah. He seemed really interested.”
“Um…”
Mole looks like he’s about to say something but stays quiet. Indeed. I was also about to ask the same thing.
“Father, how’s the penguin suit working out for you?”
That’s right. Father is currently wearing the underwater suit he obtained at Cal Mira Island.
“It’s excellent as a diving suit. I was able to go pretty deep with Sadeena-san.”
“It looks weird but works well.”
Assistant is analyzing it. Did you wear it too?
“Yeah, even when my fur got wet, it didn’t bother me.”
It seems Mole also wore it.
“Larsa-san seemed pretty creeped out by it though. But, I mean, it’s effective, so what can you do?”
“Panda ended up wearing it too.”
Is that so? By the way, just how many of these suits does Father have? For reference, I managed to procure about 20 of them. They accumulated while I was raising the Filolials.
“Thanks to Naofumi-chan, I was able to dive deep without any worries. I think I’m going to have a good time today.”
Older Sister pulls out an old bottle of alcohol from the bag she’s carrying.
“That’s the alcohol from the sunken ship that was even deeper than where Larsa-san was diving, right? Is it safe to drink?”
“It seems fine! Now, let’s enjoy this aged premium liquor that’s been sleeping for so long.”
Older Sister looks quite pleased.
“Well… I guess it’s okay? By the way, Motoyasu-kun.”
“What is it?”
“There are quite a lot of high-experience monsters in the sea. I went diving with Sadeena-san, and had Sakura-chan and Gaelion-chan fight some strong monsters. We gained a lot of experience.”
“Is that so?”

I don’t have much experience with underwater combat. Now that I think about it, after defeating Takt, Father mentioned that he took Older Sister out to improve her aptitude through experimentation, and she showed the most growth among our companions.
“If that’s the standard, then Sadeena-san…”
“I’m at level 40.”
“Do you want to class up? I can easily arrange it, but you already seem really strong.”
“Oh my, I’m happy to hear that. Well, if you’re offering, I might just consider it.”
While responding cheerfully, Older Sister gives a slightly serious look as she casually answers.
“So, Naofumi-chan, would you make me your companion too, just like Sasa-chan?”
Father agrees as if it’s only natural. Well, she is Older Sister after all.
“Of course. But, I don’t know if Sadeena-san is taking care of them or not, but I’ll also take in the child waiting for her return.”
At Father’s response, Older Sister looks puzzled.
“Oh my? And why would you think that?”

“There were hints here and there. It seems like you’ve been treating me well because there’s something you’d benefit from if I’m around. I’d like to ask for your continued support, just like with Larsa-san.”
At that, Older Sister entwines her arm around Father’s.
“Oh dear, I’ve been found out. But Naofumi-chan, you’re making one big misunderstanding.”
“Huh? What?”
Father tilts his head, looking at Older Sister, not understanding.
“The reason I like Naofumi-chan isn’t because I realized you’re a Hero. It’s because you can hold your liquor really well. I didn’t notice it at first, though.”
“Haha, I’ll take that with a grain of salt. Well then… please bring the child you’re protecting. Let’s all… have a meal together.”
“Got it. See you later.”

Older Sister waved her hand cheerfully and left. After a while, Rival and the money-obsessed panda rejoined Father, and what followed was less of a drinking party and more of a lively banquet. The recruitment of the panda, which Ren and Itsuki had been hoping for, was successfully completed. Older Sister… had brought along two demi-human children—likely the slaves that were in the village. Since drinking too much would affect the work starting the next day, Father sensibly called it a night, and the group disbanded. Older Sister apparently had a place to stay. After finishing their meal, the two children returned to that house. Since Older Sister had been recruited, she was preparing to move. As the night deepened, Ren, Itsuki, Kou, and Éclair showed up, dragging along Stalker Pig. Kou was holding Stalker Pig, who looked dazed.
“We’re back.”
“Welcome back, Itsuki, Ren. How did things go… or rather, I see you found her.”

“Yes… She was originally the daughter of a fallen noble, but she was forcibly taken as collateral for a vile debt. Even after paying, they didn’t release her and treated her terribly. We managed to rescue her with the Queen’s help, but…”
I wave my hand in front of Stalker Pig. Her eyes are lifeless. This is what they call a broken person.
“It looks like her emotional wounds run deep… And that incident… it was a hopeless situation, one where a true hero was desperately needed.”
“Seriously! This world is really full of hopeless people!” Itsuki spoke with indignation.
Compared to how he was in his world, there’s no hidden meaning behind his words. He really seems to believe that.
“I can understand why Itsuki became so obsessed with justice.”
“The noble in question certainly had issues. He was already dismissed under the authority of the Hero and by the Queen’s orders… but the damage was already done.”
“I persuaded Rishia-san’s parents and took her into my protection.”
“Bu… Bu… Bu…”
Stalker Pig is muttering dazedly, not even noticing Itsuki. Then, Itsuki turns to me.
“Motoyasu-san, if there’s another loop, please make sure to save Rishia-san.”
“I’ll consider it if I remember, of course.”
Honestly, I couldn’t care less about Stalker Pig. She’s a stalker, after all. A pathological one who chases after Itsuki no matter what.
As I was thinking that, Itsuki grabs my shoulder. He’s staring at me with a very serious look. Since there’s a slight height difference, I don’t feel much pressure.
“Please promise me you’ll save her!”
“I’ll think about it.”
Again with the same request? My answer won’t change.
“Please promise me you’ll save her!”
“I’ll think about it.”
When I said that, Itsuki glared at me again. It feels even more intense than before.
“Please promise me you’ll save her! Are you even listening!?”
“I told you, I’ll think about it.”

Even though I’ve answered multiple times, Itsuki is being persistent. Is this what they call a conversation loop? Is he planning to keep going until I nod? If it becomes a priority and I remember, I’ll tell him.
“Motoyasu, just nod and remember it properly. The outcome was really tragic!”
Even Ren is scolding me now. What a hassle…
“Was it my fault? I highly doubt it.”
“Who else is responsible besides you, Motoyasu-san!?”

Hmm… I suppose I’ll think about it seriously for a moment. What caused Stalker Pig to become obsessed with Itsuki in the first place? It’s probably because Itsuki got carried away playing hero and fell into that trap.
“It’s Itsuki’s fault, isn’t it?”
“Why would it be my fault!? Motoyasu-san, if you keep this up, I’m going to get angry!”
Itsuki’s voice is gradually getting louder and more intense. He already seems angry, though. Not that I care what happens to the pig…
“Motoyasu-kun, please. This time, not just Ren and Itsuki, okay?”
“Understood.”
“…Why are you so stubborn about this!?”
“Itsuki, it’s Motoyasu. Just give up.”
When Ren said that, Itsuki glared at him.
“Ren-san, you’re fine, aren’t you? You have your destined partners, Eclair-san and Wyndia-san… and Motoyasu-san even recognizes them both as women.”
“Why am I getting dragged into this…”
Ren slumped his shoulders in defeat.
